standards.name: Idempotent
test: Rerun three pipelines covering premium, claims, and billing for an already-processed batch in the non-prod orchestrator (Airflow)
Query the target tables in the warehouse database and compare row counts and key aggregates before and after each rerun
Open each pipeline's source in GitHub Enterprise and confirm merge-on-key, overwrite-by-partition, or equivalent dedup logic
Open the replay runbook in Confluence and confirm it documents replay scope by partition or key range
Search ServiceNow ITSM for a ticket or log showing the replay procedure was executed within the past 12 months
Pass when reruns add zero net new duplicates, aggregates match, no pipeline is INSERT-only append, and a replay ran in 12 months

standards.name: Incremental Loads
test: Open the job configuration or source for five recurring policy and claims history loads in GitHub Enterprise
Confirm each job bounds its extract with a watermark column, change-tracking token, or CDC high-water-mark, not a full scan
Open the last 30 days of run logs in the scheduler (Airflow) and check each run records start and end watermark values
Verify each run's lower bound equals the prior run's upper bound across the 30-day window
Open the job inventory register in Confluence and list all full-refresh jobs with their initial-load or recovery classification
Pass when all five jobs use watermarks, watermark continuity holds, and no unclassified full refresh runs on a recurring schedule

standards.name: Infrastructure as Code for All Environments
test: Open the IaC repo in GitHub Enterprise and confirm compute, network, storage, and security groups are defined per environment
Run terraform plan (or AWS Config drift detection) against dev, test, and prod and export the drift report
Confirm the drift report shows zero unmanaged or manually modified resources in each environment
Export the past 30 days of CloudTrail events and flag any console change without a matching IaC commit
Open the IaC workflow in GitHub Actions and confirm the drift check is a required step that blocks apply on failure
Pass when drift is zero in all environments, no out-of-band console changes exist, and the drift gate is non-bypassable

standards.name: Instant Rollback Capability
test: Open the release pipelines for three production services in GitHub Actions, including one policy and one claims service
Confirm each pipeline defines an automated rollback step such as blue/green swap, canary abort, or prior image redeploy
Open the pipeline run history in GitHub Actions and verify a rollback drill or event ran within the past 90 days per service
Open the migration scripts for the last two releases in GitHub Enterprise and confirm backward compatibility for one version
Run a simulated rollback in the test environment for one service and record time from initiation to confirmed healthy state
Pass when rollback is automated, exercised within 90 days, migrations are backward compatible, and time meets the rollback SLA

standards.name: Integration Tests for External Dependencies
test: Open the CI test inventory in GitHub Actions for each service calling MVR, credit bureau, payment, reinsurer, or state APIs
Confirm a named integration test class or file exists per external dependency in the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Run the integration test stage in GitHub Actions and confirm the run log shows sandbox or stub URLs, never production endpoints
Inspect the test cases in GitHub Enterprise for at least one timeout, HTTP 5xx, and malformed-response scenario per dependency
Confirm each failure-mode test asserts the service's error handling, not merely the absence of an exception
Open the merge gate settings in GitHub Actions and confirm a failure-mode test failure blocks the build from release
Pass when every external dependency has passing sandbox tests covering timeout, 5xx, and malformed responses, gated in CI

standards.name: Issue Logging
test: Export the issue log for a sample of five active projects from Jira
Check every open or recently closed issue has a unique ID, impact description, date raised, and severity with no blank field
Open the status reports and meeting minutes for the same period in Confluence and list every impacting problem discussed
Match each discussed problem to a Jira issue raised within one business day and flag unlogged items as process breaches
Check last-modified timestamps in Jira show weekly updates and no severity-1 issue past its target date without escalation
Pass when all mandatory fields are populated, discussed problems are logged within one business day, and breaches reach the PMO

standards.name: Issues Logged in Tracking System
test: Run a filter in Jira for all data quality issues logged in the past 90 days
Check every record has severity, affected dataset, business impact, and an assigned owner with none of the four fields missing
Pick five data quality alerts or audit findings from the same period and match each to a logged Jira issue
Filter Jira for issues idle beyond the defined aging threshold and check each carries a documented review note
Open the stewardship meeting minutes in Confluence and confirm aging review appears in the two most recent meetings
Pass when no issue lacks a mandatory field, every sampled alert is logged, and aging review is documented in both meetings

standards.name: Kept Current
test: Open the 10 most recent merged pull requests with code or config changes in GitHub Enterprise
Check each PR diff and flag any change that invalidates a README section without updating the README in the same PR
Open the onboarding checklists for the last 2 engineers onboarded to each team in Confluence
Confirm README accuracy was checked at onboarding and any inaccuracies were logged as defects in Jira
Open the repo health review records for the past 6 months in Confluence and confirm one README review completed per quarter
Pass when sampled PRs update invalidated README content in-PR and quarterly reviews raised and resolved README defects

standards.name: Language-Specific Style Guides Enforced via Linters
test: Open the CI workflow file for each approved language's repository in GitHub Actions
Confirm the language-appropriate linter (ESLint, Checkstyle) runs as a required build step
Push a branch with a deliberate style violation and open a pull request in GitHub Enterprise
Confirm the lint stage in GitHub Actions fails the build and the merge is blocked
Review the last 10 merged pull requests in GitHub Enterprise for lint bypasses without a documented approved exception
Pass when linters are required steps, the seeded violation blocks merge, and no unapproved bypass exists in the 10 PRs

standards.name: Lineage Captured
test: Open the lineage graph for three priority datasets, e.g. loss reserve, earned premium, surrender roll-forward, in Purview
Trace each graph from source system through every transformation pipeline to the final report and note any broken node
Apply a simulated schema change to one source table and run the impact-analysis function in Purview
Confirm the impact list covers all downstream stages and reports and is generated within one business day
Open the pipeline configuration records in Purview and count active pipelines requiring manual lineage entry
Pass when all three lineage paths are unbroken, impact analysis is complete and automatic, and under 5% need manual entry

standards.name: Linked to Work Item
test: Open the pre-receive hook configuration on every protected repository in GitHub Enterprise
Confirm the hook rejects commit messages lacking a work-item reference matching the pattern [A-Z]+-[0-9]+
Push a test commit with no reference to a non-production branch and confirm GitHub Enterprise rejects it citing the policy
Sample 25 recent merged commits across at least five repos and note each referenced work-item ID
Look up each ID in Jira and confirm it exists, was approved or in progress at commit time, and is not a placeholder
Pass when the hook blocks unreferenced commits and all 25 sampled commits trace to valid approved work items

standards.name: Load Tests Before Production
test: Open the change-impact assessment for each candidate release in Jira
Confirm changes touching billing, FNOL intake, or bordereaux paths are tagged as requiring a load test before promotion
Open the load test scripts in GitHub Enterprise and check the traffic model uses documented billing-peak or CAT FNOL volumes
Run the load test in the production-like environment and export the results report
Compare p95 and p99 latency and throughput line-by-line against the service's published capacity targets
Open the release gate log in GitHub Actions and find a sample run where a breached target blocked promotion
Pass when load tests use peak traffic models, results meet capacity targets, and any breach hard-blocks the release

standards.name: Manual Testing for Exploratory Only
test: Open the exploratory session records for the current release cycle in Jira (Zephyr or Xray)
Confirm each session has a written charter naming the feature, scenario scope, or usability question under investigation
Cross-reference the defect log in Jira and confirm each reproducible exploratory defect links an automated test before closure
Open the regression suite runs in GitHub Actions and confirm execution is fully automated with no manual re-execution steps
Confirm no standing manual regression test plans exist in Jira (Zephyr or Xray)
Sample five exploratory defects from the past quarter and open each linked automated test in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when every session is charter-driven and all five sampled defects link automated tests present in the codebase

standards.name: Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
test: Open the lake catalog (Unity Catalog, AWS Glue, or Azure Purview) and confirm distinct Bronze, Silver, and Gold zones exist
Open the promotion criteria in Confluence and confirm row-count thresholds, null-rate limits, and schema rules per boundary
Connect Power BI to the Bronze zone with a business-user credential and confirm access is denied or no Bronze datasets appear
Sample five Claims, Finance, or Actuarial dashboards in Power BI and confirm each reads Silver or Gold tables only
Open the onboarding checklists for three recent datasets in Confluence and confirm zone assignment and criteria sign-off
Pass when all three zones exist with written criteria, Bronze is closed to consumers, and zero sampled dashboards read Bronze

standards.name: Message schemas are registered and version-pinned
test: Open Confluent Schema Registry and enumerate every schema used by policy and partner integrations
Confirm each schema entry carries an explicit version identifier, not latest or an unversioned alias
Open the deployment configs for three channels (new business, in-force servicing, partner feed) in GitHub Enterprise
Confirm each config pins a specific schema version ID rather than a dynamic or floating reference
Attempt to register a breaking change, removing a mandatory field, under the same name and version in the registry
Pass when every schema is version-pinned in the registry and configs and the registry rejects the breaking overwrite

standards.name: Minimum 80 Percent Line Coverage
test: Open the CI pipeline definition for each in-scope codebase in GitHub Actions
Confirm a coverage gate step reads the unit test report and fails builds below 80 percent line coverage
Open the latest successful build's coverage report in GitHub Actions and check coverage is at or above 80 percent overall
Open the three most recent pull requests in GitHub Enterprise and confirm at least one was challenged for coverage inflation
Push a sample branch with coverage below the threshold to a test repo and confirm the GitHub Actions gate blocks the merge
Pass when gates enforce 80 percent, latest builds meet it codebase-wide, and the low-coverage sample merge is blocked

standards.name: Monitoring and Alerting
test: Open the metric inventory for the last 30 days in Datadog and list metrics emitted per active production pipeline
Confirm each pipeline emits run status, duration, row count, and data freshness for the full 30-day window
Open each pipeline's alert configuration in Datadog and match thresholds to the SLAs in its data contract or runbook
Review the last three failure incidents in PagerDuty and check on-call notification timestamps fall within the response window
Open the on-call rotation and runbook in Confluence and confirm updates within 90 days plus close and regulatory escalations
Pass when all four metrics exist per pipeline, thresholds map to SLAs, alerts paged in window, and the runbook is current

standards.name: Multi-AZ Deployment Required for Production
test: Export the production workload deployment inventory from the AWS console
Verify each workload places compute, database replicas, and load balancers in two or more distinct availability zones
For each single-AZ workload, open the exception record in ServiceNow ITSM and check signed risk acceptance and expiry date
Open the latest DR or resilience test results for three critical workloads in Confluence and confirm service survived AZ loss
Open the IaC templates in GitHub Enterprise and confirm policy-as-code enforces multi-AZ for the sampled workloads
Pass when all production workloads span two or more AZs or hold signed unexpired exceptions and policy blocks single-AZ
